simplebatchupload-action-add-back: Label of the button that puts a file the user skipped back among the files waiting to be uploaded. Screen readers read this label followed by {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-action-for-file}}, which names the file.
simplebatchupload-action-for-file:
Appended to the visible label of a button that acts on one file, to give screen readers a name that says which file. Not shown on screen. The button's own label comes first and cannot be moved: the Keep button is read as "Keep Example.jpg". English needs nothing but the file name; add a preposition or particle if your language needs one.
Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the file the button acts on
simplebatchupload-action-keep: Label of the button that keeps one of several files in the batch that would be uploaded under the same name; the others are not uploaded. Screen readers read this label followed by {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-action-for-file}}, which names the file.
simplebatchupload-action-replace: Label of the button that uploads a file over the file of the same name already on the wiki. Screen readers read this label followed by {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-action-for-file}}, which names the file.
simplebatchupload-action-retry:
Accessible name of the button that uploads a file again after it failed. The button shows an icon and no text, so this is read aloud by screen readers and never shown on screen.
Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the file
simplebatchupload-action-skip: Label of the button that does not upload the file, leaving the file of the same name already on the wiki as it is. Screen readers read this label followed by {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-action-for-file}}, which names the file.
simplebatchupload-action-skip-file:
Accessible name of the button that takes a file out of the batch before it is uploaded. The button shows an icon and no text, so this is read aloud by screen readers and never shown on screen.
Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the file
simplebatchupload-add-capacity:
Shown on the empty upload area, on wikis that limit how many files one batch may hold.
Parameters:
* $1 - the largest number of files one batch may hold
simplebatchupload-add-first: Shown on the empty upload area. Once the list has files in it, {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-add-more}} is shown instead.
simplebatchupload-add-hint: Shown under {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-add-first}} on the empty upload area.
simplebatchupload-add-hint-more: Shown under {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-add-more}} once the list has files in it; the empty list shows {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-add-hint}} instead. The first sentence continues the line above it: files may be dropped anywhere in the list, not only on that row.
simplebatchupload-add-more: Shown on the first row of a list that already has files in it. The empty list shows {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-add-first}} instead.
simplebatchupload-buttonlabel: Label of the button that opens the file picker.
simplebatchupload-comment: Comment saved with the upload. Do not translate '[[mw:Special:MyLanguage/Extension:SimpleBatchUpload|SimpleBatchUpload]]'
simplebatchupload-dock-attention: Accessible name of the icon on the bar above the file list, marking that files are waiting for the user to decide about them. The icon has no visible text; this is read aloud by screen readers instead.
simplebatchupload-dock-batch-progress: Accessible name of the progress bar under the summary line, which shows how far the whole batch has got. The bar has no visible label; this is read aloud by screen readers instead.
simplebatchupload-dock-failed:
Shown in the summary of a finished batch. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of files that could not be uploaded
simplebatchupload-dock-on-hold:
Shown on the bar above the file list, counting every file the batch will not upload until the user decides what to do with it: files the wiki already holds under the same name, and files in the batch that share a name with each other.
Parameters:
* $1 - the number of those files
simplebatchupload-dock-overwriting:
Shown on the bar above the file list, after {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-dock-on-hold}} and separated from it by a dot, counting only the files that share a name with another file in the same batch rather than with a file already on the wiki. The number is always two or more.
Parameters:
* $1 - the number of those files
simplebatchupload-dock-pause: Label of the button that pauses the batch. Uploads already running finish; the remaining files stay in the list, and pressing {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-dock-upload}} carries on with them.
simplebatchupload-dock-pausing:
Shown in the summary line after {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-dock-pause}} was pressed, while the uploads already running finish.
Parameters:
* $1 - the number of files still uploading
simplebatchupload-dock-ready:
Shown in the summary before the batch is started, and again if it is paused. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of files waiting to be uploaded
simplebatchupload-dock-show-all:
Label of the button that goes back to showing every file, from a list showing only the files on hold.
Parameters:
* $1 - the number of files in the batch
simplebatchupload-dock-show-on-hold:
Label of the button that narrows the list to the files waiting for the user to decide about them.
Parameters:
* $1 - the number of those files
simplebatchupload-dock-skipped:
Shown in the summary of a finished batch. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of files the user chose not to upload
simplebatchupload-dock-upload: Label of the button that uploads the files waiting in the list. Nothing is uploaded until it is pressed, and after {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-dock-pause}} it carries on with the files left.
simplebatchupload-dock-uploaded:
Shown in the summary of a finished batch. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of files that were uploaded
simplebatchupload-dock-uploading:
Shown in the summary line while the batch is running.
Parameters:
* $1 - the number of files finished, uploaded or failed
* $2 - the number of files in the batch, not counting the ones the user skipped
simplebatchupload-drop-truncated:
Shown when files were dropped and the batch could not hold all of them. How many were left out is not known, so the message does not say.
Parameters:
* $1 - the largest number of files this batch may hold
simplebatchupload-error-rename-pattern: Shown under {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-rename-find}} when {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-rename-regex}} is ticked and what it holds is not a valid regular expression, in which case no file is renamed.
simplebatchupload-estimate-minutes:
Shown above the result list while the wiki is rate limiting the batch. Parameters:
* $1 - a whole number of minutes, rounded up
simplebatchupload-estimate-under-a-minut: Shown above the result list while the wiki is rate limiting the batch and less than a minute of waiting is left. Used instead of {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-estimate-minutes}} so that no countdown in seconds is shown.
simplebatchupload-group-clash:
Heading of the section of the list holding files that share a name with another file in the same batch.
Parameters:
* $1 - the number of names shared this way, not the number of files
simplebatchupload-group-held:
Heading of the section of the list holding files the wiki already has under the same name.
Parameters:
* $1 - the number of those files
simplebatchupload-group-replace-all:
Label of the button beside the heading {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-group-held}}. Uploads all of those files over the files of the same name already on the wiki.
Parameters:
* $1 - the number of those files
simplebatchupload-group-skip-all: Label of the button beside the heading {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-group-clash}}. None of the files that share a name are uploaded.
simplebatchupload-max-files-reached:
Shown once in the result list when a file selection does not fit in the current batch. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of files that were added
* $2 - the number of files that were selected
simplebatchupload-name: {{Notranslate}} The name of the extesion as shown on special page 'Version'
simplebatchupload-rate-limit-paused: Shown under the summary line when the batch paused because the wiki refused uploads repeatedly. "Upload" is the label of {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-dock-upload}}. Do not name a specific length of time: how long the wait is depends on the wiki's configuration.
simplebatchupload-rename-count:
Says how many of the files waiting to be uploaded the rename gives a new name. Read aloud by screen readers when it changes.
Parameters:
* $1 - the number of file names that change
* $2 - the number of files waiting
simplebatchupload-rename-find: Label of the field holding the text, or regular expression, to look for in each file name.
simplebatchupload-rename-find-placeholde: Shown in the empty {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-rename-find}} field: leaving it empty puts the text of {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-rename-replace}} in front of every file name.
simplebatchupload-rename-label:
Label of a result row for a file that is renamed while uploading. Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the selected file
* $2 - the name it is uploaded under
simplebatchupload-rename-matches-nothing: Shown in place of {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-rename-count}} when the rename changes none of the file names. "Find" is {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-rename-find}}.
simplebatchupload-rename-regex: Label of the checkbox that makes {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-rename-find}} a regular expression rather than plain text.
simplebatchupload-rename-replace: Label of the field holding what replaces the text found in each file name.
simplebatchupload-rename-show-only:
Label of the button that narrows the file list to the files the rename gives a new name.
Parameters:
* $1 - the number of those files
simplebatchupload-rename-title: Title of the collapsible section with the fields that rename the files in the batch before they are uploaded.
simplebatchupload-result-network-error: Shown on the row of a file that could not be uploaded, as the reason it failed. The request never reached the server.
simplebatchupload-result-unknown-error: Shown on the row of a file that could not be uploaded, as the reason it failed. The server's answer could not be interpreted.
simplebatchupload-row-no-extension: Shown on a file waiting to be uploaded when the rename has left its new name without a file extension, which is almost always a mistake in the rename. The wiki still accepts the file and adds an extension itself.
simplebatchupload-row-nth-of:
Shown after the name of a file that shares its name with others in the batch, to tell those rows apart. Parameters:
* $1 - the position of this file among the ones sharing the name
* $2 - how many files share the name
simplebatchupload-status-clash: Accessible name of the status icon on a row whose file shares its name with another file in the batch. The row shows the icon and no text, so this is read aloud by screen readers instead.
simplebatchupload-status-done: Accessible name of the status icon on a row whose file is on the wiki. The row shows the icon and no text, so this is read aloud by screen readers instead.
simplebatchupload-status-failed: Accessible name of the status icon on a row whose file could not be uploaded. The row shows the icon and no text, so this is read aloud by screen readers instead.
simplebatchupload-status-held: Accessible name of the status icon on a row whose file has the same name as a file already on the wiki and is waiting for the user to say whether to overwrite it. The row shows the icon and no text, so this is read aloud by screen readers instead.
simplebatchupload-status-queued: Accessible name of the progress ring on a row whose file is waiting its turn. The row shows no text, so a screen reader reads this together with the progress value.
simplebatchupload-status-skipped: Accessible name of the status icon on a row whose file was deliberately not uploaded. The row shows the icon and no text, so this is read aloud by screen readers instead.
simplebatchupload-status-uploading: Accessible name of the progress ring on a row whose file is being uploaded. The row shows no text, so a screen reader reads this together with the progress value.
simplebatchupload-text-directive-not-rea: Warning shown under {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-text-title}} when the text holds something that looks like a +rename instruction: one typed into the text, which is never read, or one from the {{#batchupload:}} parser function that is not written correctly. Keep "+rename" untranslated: it is the name of the parameter. "Rename files" is {{msg-mw|simplebatchupload-rename-title}}.
simplebatchupload-text-title: Title of the collapsible section holding the wikitext every file page in the batch is created with. Also the accessible name of the text field inside it.
simplebatchupload-warning-duplicate:
Shown after a successful upload when the wiki already holds identical files. Parameters:
* $1 - a comma separated list of file names
* $2 - the number of those files
simplebatchupload-warning-exists:
Shown after a successful upload that replaced a file of the same name. Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the replaced file
simplebatchupload-warning-no-change: Shown on a result row when the wiki already held this exact content under this exact name, so the upload stored nothing new.
simplebatchupload-warning-other:
Shown after a successful upload that the server commented on. Parameters:
* $1 - a comma separated list of the server's warning identifiers, which are not translatable
* $2 - the number of those identifiers
